about.description: Clinic Cloud is an intelligent search platform for medical and scientific documentation. Access thousands of medical documents from a single point.
about.builtWithDescription: Powered by a modern stack, including Python, React, Django, PostgreSQL, Sentence Transformers, and Tailwind CSS.
about.teamDescription: Personal project by Rubén García Rodríguez
about.madeWith: Made with love for the medical community
about.license: Open source under GPL v3 license

terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.text1: By accessing and using ClinicCloud, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you disagree with any part of these terms, you should not use our service.
acceptance.text2: This service is intended solely for healthcare professionals, researchers, and students for educational and informational purposes.

service.title: 2. Service Description
service.description: ClinicCloud is an intelligent search platform for medical and scientific documentation that uses:
service.item1: Semantic search using embeddings and artificial intelligence models
service.item2: Indexing of scientific literature from public sources (PubMed, medical journals)
service.item3: Automated recommendations based on semantic similarity
service.item4: Search history and saved documents management

ai.title: 3. Use of Artificial Intelligence
ai.warning: This service uses artificial intelligence models to process and analyze medical content.
ai.model1: For semantic search and embedding generation
ai.processingText: Your searches are processed by AI models to:
ai.purpose1: Convert your query into vector representations (embeddings)

disclaimer.title: 4. Limitations and Disclaimer
disclaimer.medicalText: ClinicCloud does NOT provide professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. The information is exclusively for educational and informational purposes. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for any medical decision.
disclaimer.accuracy1: Results are automatically generated by AI systems
disclaimer.accuracy2: We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of information
disclaimer.accuracy3: AI models may generate incorrect or biased results
disclaimer.liabilityText: Under no circumstances will we be liable for direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use this service.

account.title: 5. User Account
account.registrationText: To access all features, you must create an account by providing:
account.responsibilityText: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password, and for all activities that occur under your account.

ip.title: 6. Intellectual Property
ip.content: Indexed content comes from public sources and belongs to their respective authors and publishers. ClinicCloud does not claim ownership over original scientific content.
ip.platform: The code, design, and functionality of the ClinicCloud platform are protected by copyright.

modifications.title: 7. Service and Terms Modifications
modifications.text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will take effect immediately after publication. It is your responsibility to review these terms periodically.

termination.title: 8. Termination
termination.text: We may suspend or cancel your account at any time if you violate these terms. You can cancel your account at any time from your profile settings.

law.title: 9. Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
law.text: These terms shall be governed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Spain and European regulations (GDPR). Any dispute will be resolved in the competent courts of Spain.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about these terms, you can contact us at:

terms.footer: By using ClinicCloud, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted these Terms and Conditions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.gdprNote: This policy complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) of the European Union.

data.title: 2. Data We Collect
data.accountText: When you create an account, we collect:
data.name: Name
data.passwordPurpose: Hashed with bcrypt (we never store passwords in plain text)
data.ipPurpose: For security and fraud prevention (reset tokens)
data.localStoragePurpose: auth_token, user_data, language preferences (stored locally in your browser)
data.aiNoteText: Your searches are processed by AI models (embeddings) to improve results. We do not share this data with third parties.

legal.title: 3. Legal Basis and Purpose of Processing

usage.title: 4. How We Use Your Data
usage.item1: Provide and maintain the search service
usage.item3: Process searches with AI models to improve relevance
usage.item4: Send service-related emails (password recovery, important notifications)
usage.item5: Analyze usage patterns to improve the platform
usage.item6: Ensure security and prevent service abuse
usage.noSelling: We do NOT sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing.

sharing.title: 5. Sharing Data with Third Parties
sharing.mymemory: For automatic content translation (public document text only)

rights.title: 6. Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.intro: Under GDPR, you have the following rights over your personal data:
rights.accessText: You can request a copy of all your personal data.
rights.rectificationText: You can correct inaccurate or incomplete data from your profile.
rights.erasure: 🗑️ Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)
rights.erasureText: You can delete your account and all your data from Settings > Delete Account.
rights.portabilityText: You can export your data in structured format (JSON).
rights.restrictionText: You can request that we limit the processing of your data.
rights.objectionText: You can object to processing based on legitimate interest.
rights.withdrawText: You can withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of previous processing.
rights.exerciseText: Contact us at cliniccloud.contact@gmail.com. We will respond within a maximum of 30 days.

security.title: 7. Data Security
security.intro: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
security.item1: Passwords hashed with bcrypt (we do not store passwords in plain text)
security.item2: Authentication via JWT tokens with expiration
security.item4: Single-use password reset tokens with 1-hour expiration

retention.title: 8. Data Retention
retention.item1: Account data: While your account is active
retention.item2: Search history: Until you manually delete it or close your account
retention.item3: Reset tokens: 1 hour after creation (automatic deletion)
retention.item4: Backup data: Up to 30 days after account deletion

cookies.title: 9. Cookies and LocalStorage
cookies.intro: ClinicCloud does NOT use traditional cookies. Instead, we use browser LocalStorage for:
cookies.control: You can delete this data from your browser's developer tools (Application > Local Storage). Upon logout, auth_token and user_data are automatically deleted.

transfers.title: 10. International Transfers
transfers.text: Your data is stored on servers located in the European Union. If in the future we use providers outside the EU, we will implement appropriate safeguards (EU Standard Contractual Clauses) as required by GDPR.

minors.title: 11. Minors
minors.text: ClinicCloud is intended for healthcare professionals and students over 16 years of age. We do not intentionally collect data from minors under 16. If you are a parent/guardian and believe your child has provided data, contact us to remove it.

changes.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
changes.text: We may update this policy occasionally. We will notify you of significant changes through the platform or by email. The last update date always appears at the beginning of this document.

authority.title: 13. Supervisory Authority
authority.text: If you believe we have not treated your data correctly, you have the right to file a complaint with the competent supervisory authority:

contact.title: 14. Contact and Requests
contact.text: For any questions about this policy or to exercise your GDPR rights:
contact.response: We will respond to your request within a maximum of 30 days.

privacy.footer: This privacy policy complies with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 on the Protection of Personal Data and guarantee of digital rights (LOPDGDD).

consent.title: Privacy Settings
consent.message: We use localStorage (similar to cookies) to improve your experience. This data is stored locally in your browser and helps us remember your preferences and maintain your session.
consent.necessaryText: Essential for the site to function. Includes authentication and basic preferences.
consent.functionalText: Allow us to remember your language, theme, and other interface configuration preferences.
consent.searchDesc: Your searches (only if you have an account)
consent.analyticsDesc: Anonymous data to improve the service
consent.analyticsText: We do not use analytics cookies or third-party tracking.
